items.question: What ritual object must the teacher give to the worshipped woman after the offerings?
premises: The woman has been fully worshipped with food and other comforts.
The teacher is the officiant performing the subsequent ritual action.
An offering vessel is designated to be given at that time.
items.inference: Therefore the teacher should then give the offering vessel to her.
items.plain_english: Then the teacher should indeed give the offering vessel to her.
